tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Physico-chemical characteristics of the natural A. crassicauda antimicrobial peptides, AcrAP1 and AcrAP2, and their cationicity/amphipathicity enhanced analogues, AcrAP1a and AcrAP2a. C = random coil and H = α-helix.
